description: Leading Floquet exponent sigma + i omega of the flip-flop orbit at Re = 62, row 1 of Spectre_NSd.dat, for the period T = 8.815172 (time stamp of BF_2cyl0.f00001). The pair is just above the imaginary axis: the Neimark-Sacker bifurcation sits at Re_c,2 = 61.17. Jean Zay (ifort, 16 ranks) and a workstation (ifx, 16 and 20 ranks) agree to 3e-9 in sigma and 1e-7 in omega; the tolerance 1e-6 is more than 300 times that scatter.
